name: 最新鳥人世界
english_description: A Traditional Chinese wuxia MUD drawing its plots and riddles from Jin Yong's fifteen novels. Players start out at the Dragon Gate Inn and make their way through sects and cities across the jianghu, training internal power, external martial arts, and other skills along the way — a classic wuxia framework of stats, sects, master-disciple bonds, guilds, and rankings. Deep testing traced its lineage back to cctx (Chi Cheng Tian Xia), an independent branch descended from the same original codebase.
